mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE )
mapper.select: SELECT policy.retention_policy_id, policy.policy_code, policy.policy_name, organization.organization_name, policy.policy_status, approved.version_number AS approved_version_number, approved.start_event, approved.period_value, approved.period_unit FROM seal.retention_policy policy JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = policy.owner_organization_unit_id JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = policy.owner_organization_unit_id LEFT JOIN seal.retention_policy_version approved ON approved.retention_policy_version_id = policy.current_approved_version_id ORDER BY policy.policy_code

SELECT activity.processing_activity_id, activity.activity_code, activity.activity_name, organization.organization_name, activity.activity_status, approved.version_number AS approved_version_number, approved.legal_basis_type, approved.processing_purpose FROM seal.processing_activity activity JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id LEFT JOIN seal.processing_activity_version approved ON approved.processing_activity_version_id = activity.current_approved_version_id ORDER BY activity.activity_code

SELECT policy.retention_policy_id, policy.policy_code, policy.policy_name, policy.owner_organization_unit_id, organization.organization_name, policy.policy_status, policy.current_approved_version_id, policy.version_no FROM seal.retention_policy policy JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = policy.owner_organization_unit_id JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = policy.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE policy.retention_policy_id = #{retentionPolicyId}

SELECT version.retention_policy_version_id, version.version_number, version.workflow_status, version.start_event, version.period_value, version.period_unit, version.grace_period_days, version.destruction_method, creator.display_name AS created_by_name, requester.display_name AS review_requested_by_name, approver.display_name AS approved_by_name, version.rejection_comment FROM seal.retention_policy_version version JOIN seal.retention_policy policy ON policy.retention_policy_id = version.retention_policy_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = policy.owner_organization_unit_id JOIN seal.admin_user creator ON creator.admin_user_id = version.created_by LEFT JOIN seal.admin_user requester ON requester.admin_user_id = version.review_requested_by LEFT JOIN seal.admin_user approver ON approver.admin_user_id = version.approved_by WHERE policy.retention_policy_id = #{retentionPolicyId} ORDER BY version.version_number DESC
